supersedes.reason: The first descriptor predated final release-harness reconciliation, architecture-count correction, TB01 crosswalk and retirement of the superseded workflow/matrix files. It is retained in Git history as checkpoint evidence but is not decisive release authority.

immutability_rule: During decisive qualification, src, reference, tests/frb01 and the decisive workflow must remain byte-identical to this candidate. Any production source or reference change invalidates RB1 scientific release qualification and requires a fresh candidate after governed owner qualification/canonical admission. Any decisive test-harness change also requires a fresh release candidate before rerun.
evidence_only_rule: This descriptor update and later qualification/closeout records may advance the release branch without changing the scientifically tested src/reference trees. Such evidence-only descendants must remain explicitly distinguishable from the frozen release candidate above.
historical_evidence_rule: Historical admission gates remain bound to their exact admitted heads. F-RB01 separately establishes current canonical preservation and integrated behavior without replaying historical one-delta assumptions as moving-current requirements.
scope_creep_rule: Capabilities admitted after the frozen RB1 scope remain NEXT_RELEASE by default and do not enlarge the denominator.
